def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(n['id'])
    # compute subtree sets using recursion with memoization
    memo = {}
    def get_subtree(node_id):
        if node_id in memo:
            return memo[node_id]
        subtree = {node_id}
        for child_id in children.get(node_id, []):
            subtree |= get_subtree(child_id)
        memo[node_id] = subtree
        return subtree
    # compute for all nodes
    for n in nodes:
        get_subtree(n['id'])
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removal_order = []
    # sort nodes by -depth, then id
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        # check retained children
        child_ids = children.get(nid, [])
        retained_children = [c for c in child_ids if c in retained]
        if retained_children:
            continue
        subtree = memo[nid]
        # Check if all required symbols remain after removing subtree
        retained_after = retained - subtree
        symbols_after = {node_map[nid2]['symbol'] for nid2 in retained_after}
        if not required_symbols.issubset(symbols_after):
            continue
        # remove
        retained = retained_after
        removal_order.append(nid)
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        'removed_node_ids': removal_order,
        'retained_node_ids': retained_sorted
    }
